title: 'Lego Mandalorian': Cute, silly, fun

blocks.text: Announced earlier at D23, Mano and Grogu get the Lego treatment in a new one shot special on Disney Plus. Star Wars and Lego are old friends having collaborated on some of the best (and most expensive!) Lego sets in recent years. If you’re a fan of the Lego film, then you’ll sink into this one pretty easily. The premise is that Manodo and Grogu get suckered into a surprise birthday party for Mando under the pretense of a new and dangerous bounty. Once there they get the best kind of ambush, one with friends, party hats and lots of blue milk. The short is a summary of sorts, a retelling of the three seasons of the acclaimed Mandalorian show, told in the unique Lego style. Being a recap, I’d have thought that this would be released before the Mandalorian and Grogu movie to catch people up on the story thus far but unfortunately it did not. Still, it is a blast seeing the story of Mando and Grogu retold in the off-beat, self aware style that the Lego movies are known for. It is jam-packed with visual gags that make full use of the fact that the characters and sets are lego building blocks. And the wit is there as well, as the characters take turns exaggerating events from the past, lampooning what happened or spinning tall tales, hilariously embellishing what actually took place. If anything the short suffers from being too short. There is so much material to draw from and make fun of over the three seasons of the Mandalorian that often the show seemed overly-stuffed. Taking the extra fifteen minutes to make it a full hour could have spaced the jokes out a bit more, but that’s a small little nitpick. ''Lego Mandalorian'' is a cute, silly way to look back on what was definitely a highlight of the Disney Plus Star Wars crop of shows. It does feel a bit like a farewell, especially knowing that a new season is nowhere on the horizon. It its good to know in whatever form, Mando and Grogu are fixtures now in Star Wars lore, and one way or another, they’ll keep coming back.
